#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string z;
    cin >> n >> z;
    
    int k = 0;
    int count = 0;
    int maxOutside = 0;
    int wordsInside = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c = z[i];
        switch (c) {
            case '_':
                if (k == 0) {
                    if (count > maxOutside) {
                        maxOutside = count;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (count > 0) {
                        wordsInside++;
                    }
                }
                count = 0;
                break;
            case '(':
                k = 1;
                if (count > maxOutside) {
                    maxOutside = count;
                }
                count = 0;
                break;
            case ')':
                k = 0;
                if (count > 0) {
                    wordsInside++;
                }
                count = 0;
                break;
            default:
                count++;
                break;
        }
    }
    
    if (k == 0 && count > maxOutside) {
        maxOutside = count;
    }
    
    cout << maxOutside << " " << wordsInside << endl;
    return 0;
}
